name: Carousel
looksLike: pictures you move through with left and right arrows
one featured item at a time with next and previous controls
row of dots underneath changing pictures
definition: A sequence of slides or items shown in the same space, with controls for moving between them.
whenToUse: Browsing a small set of featured items

notConfusedWith.difference: Uses labeled choices for direct access to panels rather than moving through a slide sequence.

prompts.short: Add a carousel with labeled previous and next buttons. Keep autoplay off.
prompts.detailed: Add a manually controlled carousel with labeled previous and next buttons, a visible slide position, and a named region. Keep focus on the controls as slides change, hide inactive content from keyboard and screen-reader navigation, and announce the new position politely. Use 44px targets and avoid autoplay.

<button type="button" className="min-h-11 min-w-11 px-3 focus-visible:outline-2" aria-label="Previous slide" onClick={() => setIndex((i) => (i - 1 + slides.length) % slides.length)}>Previous</button>
<button type="button" className="min-h-11 min-w-11 px-3 focus-visible:outline-2" aria-label="Next slide" onClick={() => setIndex((i) => (i + 1) % slides.length)}>Next</button>

a11yNotes: Give the carousel and its controls accessible names
Keep focus on controls and announce manual slide changes politely
Keep inactive slides out of navigation and avoid autoplay
